description.html: The Resun PO-013 is a polyresin decoration shaped like an old, moss-covered stone bridge with several artificial plants in light green and yellow-green tones. Under the arch of the bridge there is a passage fish can swim through, and the bridge itself also gives them cover. At 16 x 7.5 x 6.5 cm, the decoration is low and elongated, so it suits the front of the aquarium and smaller aquariums.

The stone and moss details look natural even up close. The plants on the bridge add greenery even to aquariums without live plants, and together with stones and sand the bridge looks like part of a natural landscape. It suits smaller fish and shrimp, which like to use the passage under the arch.

Before placing it, rinse the decoration in lukewarm water, without detergents. Set it on a flat surface so the passage under the arch stays open and does not get buried in sand. Remove algae from the stone and the plants with a soft brush during regular aquarium maintenance. The Resun PO-019 amphora decoration goes well with the bridge.
